_note:
⛔ SNG-433. THE CLASH NEWS TEMPLATES, RE-AUTHORED. Erik: 'Is it coherent? Interesting? Obvious why it's news?' — no, no and no. The old templates were mine and produced:
   'The Choirmaster Who Would Not Return — The Choirmaster Who Would Not Return withdraws to lick their wounds.' ⛔ THE FULL NAME TWICE IN ONE SENTENCE, because the template was `${winner} bested ${loser} — ${loser} withdraws`.
   'Overseer Grael of the Edge District a daughter who thinks he is a clerk' ⛔ NOT A SENTENCE — a personalVerbs fragment in a slot expecting a clause.
_shortName: ⛔ SHORT FORM ON SECOND MENTION. A figure's name is 'Neth, Who Has Buried More Than She Has Known'. Say that ONCE. After that: the part before the comma if there is one ('Neth'), else the last two words ('the Wild Half' → no; 'The Hollow King'). ⚠️ THE RULE: first mention full, every later mention short. That alone removes the stutter.
_whyItIsNews:
⛔ THE FIELD THAT MAKES A FIGHT NEWS IS `rivals`, AUTHORED ON 58 OF 66 FIGURES AND READ BY NOTHING SINCE SNG-208. 23 pairs are MUTUAL. ⚠️ A fight between rivals is not the same event as a fight between strangers, and the news must not report them in the same sentence.
   RIVALS      → name the rivalry. This is the fight people were waiting for.
   MUTUAL      → name it harder. Both of them have been waiting.
   STRANGERS   → say so. 'had not met before' is itself interesting.
_whatChanged: ⛔ 'WITHDRAWS TO LICK THEIR WOUNDS' READ THE SAME WHETHER THE LOSER WAS OUT FOR EIGHT DAYS OR HAD LOST A WAR. Every line must now carry the CONSEQUENCE, and the four outcomes are four different sizes of event.

killed.rival: {W} killed {L} at {place}. They had been circling each other for years; {w} did not gloat, and did not stay.
killed.mutual: {W} killed {L} at {place} — the ending both of them had been walking toward. {w} left the field alone.
killed.stranger: {W} killed {L} at {place}. They had never met. {l} is not coming back.
killed._power: {W} killed {L} at {place} — {power}. {l} is not coming back.

wounded.rival: {W} broke {L} at {place}, and it was personal. {l} is out of the reckoning while the wound holds.
wounded.mutual: {W} and {L} finally met at {place}. {w} walked away from it; {l} did not, and will not be seen for a season.
wounded.stranger: {W} broke {L} at {place} — a stranger, and now an enemy. {l} is out of the reckoning while the wound holds.
wounded._power: {W} broke {L} at {place} with {power}. {l} is out of the reckoning while the wound holds.

checked.rival: {W} held {L} at {place}. Neither will call it a defeat, and both know what it was. {l}'s design is stalled, not stopped.
checked.mutual: {W} and {L} met at {place} and nothing was settled — which suits {w} and does not suit {l}.
checked.stranger: {W} turned {L} back at {place}. {l} learned something, which is worse for everyone else.
checked._power: {W} held {L} at {place} — {power} — and {l}'s design is stalled, not stopped.

stalemate.rival: {W} and {L} met at {place}. Neither could break the other, and neither has ever been able to.
stalemate.mutual: {W} and {L} met at {place} and stopped, both standing. ⛔ THE THIRD TIME. Nobody is betting on it any more.
stalemate.stranger: {W} and {L} met at {place} and neither could break the other. They will both be thinking about it.
stalemate._power: {W} and {L} met at {place}; {power} was not enough, and neither was anything {l} had.

_placeholders:
{W} full winner name (first mention) · {w} short winner · {L} full loser · {l} short loser · {place} location DISPLAY NAME, never an id · {power} the ability's short description.
⚠️ IF `place` IS NULL, DROP ' at {place}' RATHER THAN PRINTING 'at null'. If `power` is null use the non-`_power` variant. ⛔ NEVER PRINT A RAW ID — that is the 'the the_ceaseless' fault again.
_pick: ⛔ CHOOSE BY RELATIONSHIP FIRST, THEN POWER. If the two are mutual rivals use `mutual`; else if either lists the other use `rival`; else `stranger`. ⚠️ Use `_power` in place of the chosen variant roughly one time in three when an abilityId exists — the power should feel like a detail the teller happened to know, not a stat line on every entry.

fragments._note: ⛔ THE VERBLESS LINES. 'Sister Alder, the Ward That Does Not Break learning a faster road' and 'Overseer Grael a daughter who thinks he is a clerk' are a NAME concatenated to a personalVerb fragment. ⚠️ THE FRAGMENTS ARE FINE — the slot needed a clause and got a phrase.
fragments._example: 'Sister Alder was seen learning a faster road.' · 'Word from the Heights: Overseer Grael, a daughter who thinks he is a clerk.'
